projects.name: Frontier AI Valuation Lab
projects.summary: A financing workspace that connects capital objectives, ownership scenarios and a reviewable decision.
projects.scenario: Compare hypothetical financing plans, change a retained-ownership objective and inspect where the ranking changes.
projects.inspect: Follow the shared calculation engine and Node API, then compare with the independent Python reference and verification guide.
projects.limits: Independent research with illustrative assumptions; company names imply no affiliation or endorsement.

projects.name: LineageGuard Studio
projects.summary: Typed review workflows with evidence, policy checks and recovery.
projects.scenario: Compare saved standard and strict synthetic reviews, inspect both exports before showing differences, and distinguish recorded decisions from current evidence freshness.
projects.inspect: Try the Studio inspector and recovery workflow, then use the native two-file comparison command. Follow the semantic inspection, owned byte snapshots and unchanged comparison contracts.
projects.limits: Synthetic demonstration; optional DataHub integration is read-only. Saved-export checks establish internal consistency, not source truth, authenticated approval or migration authority. Production behavior needs separate verification.
projects.command:
node scripts/studio-review.mjs --scenario=safe-add --profile=standard --output=./.lineageguard/compare-standard.json
node scripts/studio-review.mjs --scenario=safe-add --profile=strict --output=./.lineageguard/compare-strict.json
node scripts/studio-compare.mjs --left=./.lineageguard/compare-standard.json --right=./.lineageguard/compare-strict.json
# Use new export paths when repeating; existing outputs are never overwritten.

projects.name: SaaS Analytics Warehouse
projects.summary: A reproducible analytics pipeline for MRR, retention and unit economics.
projects.scenario: Build a fictional subscription warehouse, then trace one historical month from the MRR bridge to customer records, payment-failure losses and channel/reason totals.
projects.inspect: Follow the read-only investigation through exact-cent customer-count, total-loss and payment-failure-subset reconciliation. Tests retain historical churn after reactivation and refuse broken joins or inconsistent source data before writing reports.
projects.limits: Seeded fictional SaaS data; results describe the fixture, not a real business.
projects.command:
uv sync --locked
make data build MONTHS=24 SCALE=0.25
uv run python -m saasreport.churn --month 2024-12 --output-dir ../tallyloom-churn-2024-12

projects.name: Impact Ledger
projects.summary: Participation and spending reporting with a local API and atomic CSV imports.
projects.scenario: Preview an attendance import, resolve validation errors, import it and compare unique participants with attendance and session spending.
projects.inspect: Follow preview/import shared validation, exact money arithmetic and calendar-period comparison through API and browser tests.
projects.limits: Hosted preview is read-only and synthetic. Writes require running the local application.
projects.command:
python3 -m impact_ledger --db .local/demo.db seed
python3 -m impact_ledger --db .local/demo.db serve

projects.name: ContrastKit
projects.summary: Color contrast auditing across a web app, library and CLI.
projects.scenario: Download a failing palette and selected pair as tokens JSON, audit it with the CLI, apply the suggested fix and confirm the next downloaded file passes.
projects.inspect: Follow real browser JSON export into the built CLI. Tests preserve the pair and target, gate invalid names and keep actual colors unchanged by color-vision simulation.
projects.limits: Color checks support accessibility work; they do not constitute a complete accessibility audit.
projects.command:
npm ci
npm test
npm run build

projects.name: MOTIONX Studio
projects.summary: A motion-led studio website with a separate outreach-validation workflow.
projects.scenario: Explore the responsive studio pages, then inspect how the separate Python workflow validates outreach inputs.
projects.inspect: Follow the frontend structure and architecture notes; review validation boundaries independently of the public website.
projects.limits: Public site and validation tooling are separate. A website preview does not demonstrate outreach delivery or client adoption.

projects.name: RelayBox
projects.summary: A durable signed-webhook inbox with idempotency and fenced worker leases.
projects.scenario: Deliver the same signed event twice, process the job and inspect retry, lease and recovery behavior locally.
projects.inspect: Follow ingestion uniqueness, transactional lease ownership and worker receipt handling; inspect the local diagnostic dashboard.
projects.limits: Local single-host SQLite service. Diagnostic samples are not throughput or service-level claims.
projects.command:
python3 -m relaybox --db .local/demo.sqlite3 demo
python3 -m relaybox --db .local/demo.sqlite3 serve --demo-secret

projects.name: TraceBench
projects.summary: Offline evaluation of recorded AI outputs with exact supplied-cost accounting and regression gates.
projects.scenario: Evaluate a bilingual recorded fixture, compare a baseline and inspect a deliberately failing regression or budget rule.
projects.inspect: Read strict input contracts and the JSON/Markdown/HTML reports, then trace reusable CI gate behavior.
projects.limits: Evaluates supplied recorded outputs; it does not call a model or measure live model quality.
projects.command: python3 -m tracebench evaluate --cases fixtures/cases.jsonl --outputs fixtures/clean.jsonl --pricing fixtures/pricing.json

projects.name: quantkit
projects.summary: Options pricing, portfolio optimization and backtesting checked against independent references.
projects.scenario: Generate fictional prices, estimate monthly risk-parity allocations using only prior closes and compare against equal weight on the same dates and costs. Inspect six CSV exports.
projects.inspect: Follow estimation-window receipts, targets and wealth exports. Future-price perturbation tests keep earlier allocations fixed; the comparison includes shared warmup and entry costs.
projects.limits: Educational quantitative software using illustrative inputs; no investment recommendation or live execution.
projects.command:
uv sync
uv run python examples/walk_forward_risk_parity.py

projects.name: powerlift
projects.summary: Experiment statistics with power analysis, CUPED, sequential monitoring and Bayesian tools.
projects.scenario: Read a seeded per-user experiment CSV, check the allocation and outcome window, then compare raw and CUPED-adjusted estimates with uncertainty.
projects.inspect: Follow the complete experiment readout from CSV validation through SRM and horizon gates to CUPED. Try the blocked scenarios before inspecting the statistical library references.
projects.limits: Statistical results depend on study design and data assumptions; a significant result alone is not a business decision.
projects.command:
uv sync
uv run python examples/experiment_readout.py --as-of 2026-09-15

projects.name: ledgerline
projects.summary: A double-entry ledger API with immutable balanced entries and idempotent writes.
projects.scenario: Run a disposable local HTTP wallet: deposit, transfer, retry with the same key, reject an overdraft, reverse the transfer and reconcile current and historical balances.
projects.inspect: Follow the one-command receipt: replay identity, unchanged rejected-write balances, reversal links, historical state and zero trial balance. The example owns and cleans up its temporary database and server.
projects.limits: Engineering demonstration; it is not a bank, payment processor or accounting system certification.
projects.command:
uv sync
uv run python examples/wallet_demo.py

projects.name: searchlite
projects.summary: A full-text search engine with explainable ranking and retrieval evaluation.
projects.scenario: Compare retrieval configurations in the browser, inspect query-level regressions and download the full comparison. Then index local notes and check your own labelled questions against explicit relevance thresholds.
projects.inspect: Follow shared retrieval settings through browser/native report parity, bounded snapshot-only evaluation and real-process exit codes. Reproduce raw timing samples at 1,000 and 10,000 synthetic documents with the benchmark method and machine context.
projects.limits: Small in-memory library. Authored glossary judgments and repeated-vocabulary timing fixtures do not establish general retrieval quality or production latency; local reports may contain private query text and document IDs.
projects.command:
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
searchlite_review_dir=$(mktemp -d)
node examples/search-docs.js index examples/fixtures/relevance-notes "$searchlite_review_dir/notes.json"
node examples/search-docs.js evaluate "$searchlite_review_dir/notes.json" examples/fixtures/relevance-notes/judgments.json

projects.name: citecheck
projects.summary: Document question answering with retrieved citations, claim checks and abstention evaluation.
projects.scenario: Index the sample handbook, ask a supported question and compare with a question the documents cannot answer.
projects.inspect: Follow real SQLite indexing, retrieval and sentence-citation checks. Markdown fence regressions verify that example headings remain under their enclosing source section.
projects.limits: Offline fixture responses are hand-written. Live answers require provider configuration and may incur usage charges.
projects.command:
uv sync
uv run citecheck index examples/handbook
uv run citecheck ask "What is the deadline for submitting an expense?"

projects.name: ProofCast
projects.summary: Local media generation with provenance records and optional object storage.
projects.scenario: Generate a local asset bundle, verify the saved manifest against its actual media files, then alter a copied file and inspect the explicit failure.
projects.inspect: Follow the offline verification CLI, byte digests and media-format checks. Reproduce missing-file, tamper and moved-bundle cases without uploading anything.
projects.limits: Local workflow demonstration. A digest identifies bytes; it does not prove authorship or the truth of media content.

projects.name: Luma Keys
projects.summary: Offline piano practice with score views, planned fingering and graded sight reading.
projects.scenario: Build a disposable browser session, generate an exercise, play clean and flawed timed runs, then inspect saved progress and repeat the exact seed.
projects.inspect: Run five sight-reading stories and inspect screenshots, failure receipts, owned-server cleanup and Web Audio practice grading without optional engines.
projects.limits: Browser QA uses synthetic exercises with 3-D hands off on macOS/Linux. Physical input, native packaging and optional engines need separate verification.
projects.command:
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npx playwright install chromium --only-shell
npm test
npm run qa:browser -- --output-dir .qa-runs/reviewer-exercise

projects.name: Blast Radius Daily
projects.summary: A one-minute Reddit puzzle about downstream effects of schema changes.
projects.scenario: Pick a UTC incident day, place two circuit breakers, trace the real cascade, compare the computed result, move one synthetic vote, then delete and replay.
projects.inspect: Open the playable offline build or produce its single HTML yourself. Follow the shared engine, exact source/build lock and maintained offline Chromium journey.
projects.limits: Desktop/landscape pointer demo; fictional community data lives in tab memory and reload resets it. Comments are unavailable. Live Reddit/Redis behavior, keyboard-only canvas play and portrait layout require separate verification.
projects.command:
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build:demo
# Open dist-demo/blast-radius-demo.html from disk
npx playwright install chromium --only-shell
npm run test:demo

projects.name: Agentic Trading Research
projects.summary: An offline research architecture with a runnable fail-closed review gate.
projects.scenario: Run six synthetic gate scenarios and inspect why missing or contradictory evidence blocks a research result.
projects.inspect: Follow schema validation, gate reasons and negative tests; compare the architecture with the runnable subset.
projects.limits: Research-review-only demonstration with synthetic fixtures; no automated orders, brokerage connection or trading advice.
projects.command:
python3 -B examples/fail_closed_gate.py --all
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s examples -p "test_*.py" -v

projects.name: JUST-QR
projects.summary: A minimal browser QR generator with image export.
projects.scenario: Generate and export a QR code, try an invalid or oversized destination, recover with a valid URL and compare clipboard/download images.
projects.inspect: Read URL validation and recovery in the single-page implementation, then inspect independent QR decoding and quiet-zone pixel checks for both export paths.
projects.limits: Browser utility; a QR code encodes input and does not validate whether the destination is trustworthy.

projects.name: Teen Budgeting
projects.summary: A classroom budgeting application using fictional examples.
projects.scenario: Explore the budgeting flow and compare the displayed spending categories and totals with the source.
projects.inspect: Read the course-project setup, server routes and frontend interactions; keep its classroom scope in view.
projects.limits: Coursework demo with fictional data; no persistent authentication or real financial accounts.
projects.command:
npm ci
npm test
npm run build
npm run dev
